kpi-card.purpose: Summarize one operational metric with value, delta, threshold tone, owner, and a clear path to investigation.
useWhen: A dashboard needs a scannable metric that can lead to detail.
The metric has a known calculation, cadence, and comparison period.
Multiple KPIs must align in a dense desktop band.
doNotUseWithoutReview: The number has no owner, source, or refresh cadence.
The KPI is only decorative and does not inform a decision.
The metric needs chart exploration instead of a compact summary.
foundations: Defines metric band density, tile min width, comparison placement, and responsive wrapping.
Owns metric label, delta copy, threshold explanation, and empty/loading language.
Controls neutral, success, warning, and danger emphasis without replacing the data.
Loaded, loading, empty, stale, warning, and selected states are explicit.
KPI groups remain flat in dashboard bands; depth appears only for drill-in overlays.
Value, label, delta, and tone are text-backed and readable without color.
slots: Primary label, value, delta, tone, and optional icon.
Cadence, owner, threshold, or stale state metadata.
Drill-in or investigation action when the KPI is actionable.
Represents loading, empty, or unavailable data.
variants: Several KPIs align in a dense responsive row.
Tone indicates risk with text-backed threshold copy.
Skeleton or stale metadata appears without shifting layout.
motion: Updated values change without decorative count-up motion.
Action feedback is immediate and keeps dashboard context.
Any live-update emphasis is removed when reduced motion is requested.
accessibility: The metric label and value are exposed as text.
Delta and tone are not color-only.
Loading and stale states are announced through text.
tests: KPI band wraps without clipping at desktop and tablet widths.
Risk tone has text-backed threshold copy.

canDecide: Use KPI Card when the metric is known, owned, and action-oriented.
Use Design System semantic tone for threshold state.
Use Skeleton or Empty State when data is not ready.
mustAsk: Metric source, calculation, cadence, threshold, or owner is unclear.
The KPI affects financial, compliance, or regulated reporting.
rejectIf: The metric has no source or owner.
The tile cannot explain stale or missing data.
miel.handoff: Confirm metric source, owner, cadence, threshold rules, drill-in destination, and loading/stale states.
